costs.disclaimer: Prices may change based on each provider's current rates (Fal.ai, Evolink, DubVoice). This catalog reflects prices at the last Vimo update. If you spot a different value, let us know.
costs.tituloVideo: How much each video costs you
costs.tituloImagenes: How much each image costs you
costs.tituloVoces: How much each audio costs you
costs.subtituloVideo: Mix image provider + voice and see total cost for 5/10/20 min.
costs.subtituloImagenes: Compare Fal vs Evolink batch by batch (40 / 220 / 446 images).
costs.subtituloVoces: 1 credit = 1 character in DubVoice. Linear cost based on script length.
costs.notaVideo: * Estimates: narration at ~150 words/min (≈13 chars/sec) · ~1 scene every 7s.
costs.notaImagenes: Columns 40 / 220 / 446 are reference figures for short / medium / long videos.
costs.notaVoces: 1 credit = 1 character. Linear pricing: $11.90 per 1,000,000 characters.

catalogo.cuadrado: Square. Cropped to 16:9 (loses a lot of image).
catalogo.sunoCreditos: ~50–200 credits per generation (varies by model and song length).
catalogo.sunoNotas: Generates 2 variations per call so you pick your favorite. Models: suno-v5-beta (recommended) and suno-v4.5plus-beta. You can choose instrumental or with vocals. Download links are valid for 72 hours.

settings.ubicacionDescripcion: Root folder where Vimo will store your projects. Inside, each project gets its own folder with its scenes, its music and the final video.
settings.soloEscritorio: This section is only available in the desktop app.
settings.errorNoEscribible: That folder is not writable. Pick another one.
